note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English; the alate is recorded in the original as 'Not known', so only the soldier and worker sections are given; the measurements have been kept verbatim and rendered as ranges with a dash; in the figure captions the species name appears under OCR as balwaitii, and the text follows balwanti.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is recorded in the original as 'Not known'. Soldier total length about 3.3—4.0 mm, worker about 2.80—3.50 mm; soldier mandibles 0.73—0.78 mm long, the postmentum club-shaped with the waist slightly behind the middle; soldier antennae 12—14-segmented (mostly 14), worker 13—14-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule milky white to yellowish brown; body white; mandibles dark brown. Head medium-sized, body densely covered with coarse hairs. Total length about 3.3—4.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, about one and a half times as long as wide (head length to the base of the mandibles 1.00—1.10, width 0.70—0.75 mm); sides parallel, posterior margin rounded; anterior part inflated, with a median longitudinal groove; anterior part of the frons steeply sloping. Fontanelle very small, opening into a small brown tube, situated at the base of the median longitudinal groove. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 12—14-segmented (mostly 14), segment 3 variable, generally as long as or slightly longer than segment 4. Labrum triangular (length including the apical spine 0.30—0.38, width 0.20—0.25 mm), with a long, pointed, transparent apical spine; a pair of long hairs at the base of the spine and a few other short hairs on the disc. Anteclypeus transparent, band-like, hairless; postclypeus separated from the frons by a pale line. Mandibles slender, sword-shaped, 0.73—0.78 mm long, about 3/4 of the head capsule, mandible length/head length index 0.68—0.78, otherwise as in the genus. Postmentum long, club-shaped (length 0.70—0.88, maximum width 0.30—0.35, waist width 0.15—0.18 mm); the waist slightly behind the middle; the wider part with a few short hairs. Pronotum flat, subreniform; length 0.30—0.35, width 0.50—0.55 mm; anterior margin weakly concave to broadly and more deeply concave; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Legs slender, tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate, rather densely hairy; cerci 2-segmented; stylet single-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; body paler. Head and body with moderately dense hairs. Total length about 2.80—3.50 mm. Head capsule subsquare, slightly wider than the head length to the base of the mandibles (head length to the base of the mandibles 0.73—0.85, maximum width 0.75—0.85 mm). Eyes and ocelli absent. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13—14-segmented. Postclypeus weakly raised, less than half as long as wide. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat (length 0.25—0.33, width 0.40—0.55 mm), slightly upturned anteriorly; anterior margin deeply concave in the middle. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
